10443014.en: Dear cultivator, you, hahahaha, so righteous and noble, I... hahahaha, admire you, hahaha, and accept your kindness, HAHAHAHA—

10443015.en: But, hahaha, if our Sects ever come into conflict, I'll still fight with all my might, HAHAHA—

10443016.en: I shall, hahaha, await your next move, HAHAHAHA.

10443017.en: A dangerous glint flashes in the enemy Sect Leader's eyes, as if his fighting spirit has been ignited. But this brief display of authority instantly crumbles as he breaks into another fit of hysterical laughter...

10443018.en: Tee-hee! When the time comes, let's have our battle while laughing like this, shall we?

10443019.en: {name|B} gives a slight smile and walks away, never sparing another glance at the person.

10443020.en: Enemy Sect Leader becomes Fearless in Peril, ATK +20%

10443021.en: Hmph, hahahaha, not a bad plan. You take our resources to strengthen your own power, hahah—a. As our sect wanes, yours will wax, and our sect will, HAHA—hahahaha, be powerless to compete with you.

10443022.en: Very well, hahahaha, today I have no choice, haha—ha, but to yield. The resources will be delivered shortly. Farewell!

10443023.en: Sigh, I was still hoping to play with this fellow a bit more, but then you showed up. Oh well, I'll do that another day. I'm off now.

10443024.en: {name|B} gives you a slight smile before turning to leave.

10443025.en: Hmph, hahahaha, not a bad plan. You take our resources to strengthen your own power, hahah—a. As our sect wanes, yours will wax, and our sect will, HAHA—hahahaha, be powerless to compete with you.

10443026.en: Hahaha, keep dreaming, HAHA, your impossible dreams! How could I, hahahaha, be threatened by you? Ha—ha, come fight!

10443027.en: Amid wild laughter, the figure before you suddenly erupts into action, launching an assault like collapsing mountains and raging waves...

10443028.en: Tsk, what a thick-headed fool. Under my control, but still dared to attack! Here, take this—I looted it from the person. It's free for the taking.

10443029.en: {name|B} smiles as she hands the items to you, then vanishes into the distance in the blink of an eye.

10443030.en: A cultivator lies bound to the ground by energy shackles, while a monster crouches on all fours, roaring and snarling at the helpless victim.

10443031.en: No matter how grandly you speak of {name|A}, I don't care! I will never join {name|A}'s Sect!

10443032.en: No matter, then just stay there like that. After I leave, there'll be no one to control this monster. Whether it bites off a chunk of your flesh or swallows you whole—well, that's anyone's guess.

10443034.en: I offered you kind words of advice, yet you refused to listen. What reason do I have to stay?

10443035.en: Alright, alright! Let me go! I'll do what you say.

10443036.en: Very good. You may go now. Remember to approach {name|A} respectfully and speak properly—do I make myself clear?

10443038.en: The cultivator grinds his teeth in anger but finds himself completely powerless to resist. With no other choice, he lets out a bitter grunt and storms away, seething with resentment.

10443039.en: It was just a little joke—nothing to take too seriously.

10443040.en: That person looked bored and restless, so I had the monster keep {gender2|C} company. Now {gender|C} seems entertained enough, so I sent the monster away.

10443041.en: That person was making some unwise choices, getting mixed up with a monster. I merely offered some friendly persuasion.

10443042.en: {name|B} flashes you a graceful smile, then turns and glides away...

10443043.en: You paid no heed to the scene before you and departed without a word.

10443044.en: A cultivator ahead suddenly approaches you, then drops to their knees in deep reverence.

10443045.en: Greetings, honorable Sect Leader! I wish to pledge my service to you—to devote my very life to your cause until my dying breath!

10443047.en: Most illustrious Sect Leader, your divine wisdom knows no bounds, your brilliant strategies are flawless, and your radiance illuminates all under heaven! I pledge my undying loyalty—no sacrifice is too great! Your will is my absolute command! Should you command me to a direction, I shall never take a step in reverse!

10443048.en: Yes! Yes! Your insight into human nature is unmatched—you can instantly tell the worth of those who seek to join! With your supreme talent for choosing capable followers, the Sect shall surely flourish and unite all the world under your rule!

10443049.en: Wait, you... you don't want me? Well... fine! Your wisdom and might inspire absolute devotion and boundless admiration! Your greatness is like that of the highest mountain! Uh... I'll just take my leave now...

10443050.en: Oh my, I always feel like Fallen Valley hides countless secrets.

10443051.en: Oh my, I always feel like Fallen Valley hides countless secrets. I really want to go take a look!

10443052.en: Wonderful! I think that place holds many mysteries of life. I've been wanting to conduct a thorough investigation! But don't worry—I can find some tributaries of Fallen Valley that are much safer than the main one! I'll wait for you there, okay?

10443053.en: I feel there are still quite a few dangers in there. Should we—should we prepare ourselves better before going in?

10443054.en: Thank you... thank you for being willing to accompany me. I'll keep exploring, and I—I want you to stay with me... would that be okay? When you... have free time, please visit me more often! Even just chatting would be wonderful!

10443055.en: {name|B}'s face flushes as she speaks, and she hurriedly turns around and leaves.

10443056.en: Let's—let's go in quickly, shall we? Please?

10443057.en: The cave ahead lies in pitch darkness, but as you both enter, blue lights gradually begin to glow, scattered like stars and illuminating the inner cavern. Those blue lights float like butterflies, dancing gracefully as they drift leisurely there.

10443058.en: Whoa, that's so beautiful! These soul fragments may be incomplete, but they're still so full of life!

10443059.en: {name|B} watches the glowing butterflies drifting leisurely about, clearly delighted. She becomes so entranced that she begins following the butterflies' dance, but the moment she notices you standing right beside her, she immediately stops and stands there blushing.

10443060.en: Oh my, I got a bit carried away... I was just watching these soul fragments and feeling how this place is so full of vitality. I found it absolutely fascinating...

10443061.en: You take {name|B}'s hand and begin dancing to the rhythm of those soul fragments. At first, her movements are constrained and stiff, but gradually she begins to move freely, her hands flowing gracefully and her eyes sparkling with life as she glances about. Her every gesture and expression radiates gentle beauty.

10443062.en: Thank you so much... I'm really happy!

10443063.en: {name|B} moves with graceful steps, leaning against you as you dance together. Waves of warm energy flow from her body, and you respond to each other in perfect harmony. Through your shared dance, you gradually enter a transcendent state, feeling waves of bliss coursing through your entire being.

10443064.en: As time passes, the sense of fulfillment between you both gradually fades. {name|B} comes back to her senses, lowering her head and not daring to look at you. She seems like she wants to say something, but simply turns away and leaves with flushed cheeks.

10443065.en: Finding no danger within, {name|B} looks around the cave with great interest for a moment, then reaches out to collect some soul fragments before cheerfully following you as you leave this place.

10443066.en: These are for you. These soul fragments are all sentient beings, so you must use them well!

10443067.en: At that time, {name|B} is busy tinkering with something in her inner room, alternating between deep contemplation and sketching designs on her blueprints, completely absorbed in her work.

10443068.en: I... want to make some implements that can contain the Fallen Valley's soul fragments. You... you call these Artifacts, right?

10443069.en: Um, how about I give you one to try out? But I'm rather clumsy with my hands and often don't make them very well... please do not think poorly of it!

10443070.en: Not far ahead, {name|B} is tugging at a cultivator while chattering away incessantly. The cultivator's face shows clear disgust, wanting nothing more than to shake off her persistent pestering.

10443071.en: You need not try to persuade me. Today I will definitely kill {name|A}—my mind is made up!

10443072.en: All this fighting and killing is so terrible, isn't it? Harmony is precious in all things! Besides, what if {name|A} accidentally kills you? That would be awful too!

10443073.en: Outrageous! Are you saying that I'm inferior to {name|A}?

10443074.en: Seeing the other party getting angry, {name|B} hastily tries to calm the person down. Seeing their fury eases slightly, she continues chattering away with her persistent attempts at persuasion.

10443075.en: Ugh! You've been pulling at me and talking nonstop for four whole hours! Aren't you tired? Enough! I won't seek revenge today!

10443076.en: The cultivator flicks their sleeve dismissively and departs. Seeing that she has successfully talked your enemy out of a revenge, {name|B} finally breathes a sigh of relief.

10443077.en: Could you... accompany me to Fallen Valley? I still want to go find some more things there.

10443078.en: I'll give you some Ultima Sand—my portion too. When you're ready, come find me, okay? I'll be waiting for you over there.

10443079.en: Fallen Valley is dark and dangerous, utterly silent as death, yet within it lie vibrant lives. Sometimes when I see those drifting soul fragments here, I find them so beautiful.

10443080.en: They're like stars or butterflies. I always want to watch them with you, watching these soul fragments. Ah! I... I didn't specifically ask you to come with me to enjoy the view! I, I really do want to find something...

10443081.en: As {name|B} keeps talking, she becomes increasingly nervous. Her explanations grow incoherent, and the more she talks, the more flustered she becomes. Finally, she sighs in defeat and, blushing shyly, stuffs a pile of items into your hands before hurrying away.

10443082.en: You see {name|B} sitting by the roadside, her body covered in filth and bearing several serious wounds. Lying motionless on the ground before her is a Mythical Beast that appears to have been forcibly subdued by her.

10443083.en: How did you find me here? Uh... I was walking along the road and got attacked by a Mythical Beast, but fortunately, I defeated the creature! I'm still quite powerful, aren't I? Haha! Oh, this is a treasure I got from defeating the monster. I have no use for it—you take it.

10443084.en: {name|B} hastily stuffs the treasure into your hands, then limps away toward the <r>Workshop in the distant city</r>...

10443085.en: Hmm... do you really want to craft this item? The cinnabar for inscribing the spell requires your essence blood—this will cost you fifty years of your lifespan...

10443086.en: You... don't underestimate me! These mere fifty years are nothing to me—my body is in excellent condition!

10443087.en: Fifty years may be nothing, but sacrificing your essence blood will damage your body. Please think twice...

10443088.en: It's fine! Please help me! You said you needed materials from a Mythical Beast, and I've already brought them for you.

10443090.en: The lady prepared a casket of cinnabar for inscribing spells for {name|B}, then shook her head and departed. {name|B} then used the Workshop to craft the artifact herself, and only after completing it in a short while did she finally breathe a sigh of relief.

10443091.en: Oh, what are you doing here? I just happened to make a little trinket for you—please be sure to take it and keep it with you. This thing looks quite ordinary, but it can protect you in certain critical moments.

10443092.en: Of course, putting oneself in danger is never good—a gentleman does not stand beneath a crumbling wall. Supreme harmony cannot be overcome, and maintaining balance while preserving peace is the way of longevity and endurance. It's best to avoid taking risks whenever possible. Well... I'm not trying to lecture you, I'm just worried that you might unknowingly find yourself in danger.

10443093.en: After {name|B} rambled on and on, she seemed to realize she had said too much. Her face and ears turned crimson all at once, and she hurriedly lowered her head, stuffing the artifact into your hands before turning around and rushing away in embarrassment.

10443094.en: Oh my, I feel like we haven't had enough fun yet, but I'm getting a bit tired. Should we play a little longer before heading back?

10443095.en: I'm feeling a bit tired. How about we go do something else instead?
